selection: The default candidate has the lowest saved pooled one-year mean absolute error among registered model candidates for this outcome. It is the same candidate for every country, selected after this descriptive comparison, not independently confirmed. All methods, including persistence, remain available.

conditional.note: Conditional wellbeing replay uses actual target-year drivers and coefficients frozen at 2016. It is not a forecast. Its 61-row mask differs from the 69-row forecast mask; pooled errors are not a controlled comparison of input quality.

provenance.operation: Read saved annual paths and metrics only; no refitting, rescoring or change to evaluation artifacts.

objective.attribution: World Bank, World Development Indicators; underlying national accounts/ILO/UN/national statistical sources documented in raw indicator metadata.
objective.license: CC BY 4.0, as stated in World Bank indicator metadata glossaries
objective.revisions: Latest retrieved vintage; historical observations can incorporate later revisions or source modeling. API lastupdated retained per response. No historical release-vintage reconstruction.
objective.exposure: Full series were loaded by acquisition/cleaning before evaluation; outcomes were not blinded or withheld from agent context.

caveats: Limited preselected eight-country demonstration (USA, IND, DEU, GBR, BRA, JPN, ZAF, CHN); pooled results do not represent the full world panel.
Latest-vintage retrospective reconstruction; not real-time forecasts. Annual survey year is not release date.
Previously studied outcome periods are not untouched holdouts.
Conditional replay uses realized target-year drivers; these are conditional one-year reconstructions, not deployable forecasts.
Rolling forecasts use data dated at or before t-1, but source revisions can contain later information.
World Bank drivers differ from the WHR six-factor model and do not include same-survey social variables.
Results do not identify causal effects or validate post-AI scenarios.
Annual targets are public-chart transcriptions rounded to three decimals, not a bulk original Gallup annual data release; chart extraction and limited validation add measurement risk.
wellbeing.targetPrecision: Public-chart transcription reconstructed from rendered annual SVG marks and axis ticks, rounded to three decimals; spot-checked against visible annual tooltips.
wellbeing.targetLicense: WHR / Gallup dashboard attribution retained. Redistribution license not independently verified; these target transcriptions are not claimed to inherit the repository code license or the World Bank CC BY license.
